pedestrian_crossing_intention_qa.Temporal_Reason: The pedestrian maintains a consistent standing posture across all 15 frames without any preparatory movements, head turns toward traffic, or forward leaning that would suggest crossing intent.

pedestrian_crossing_intention_qa.Conclusion: The pedestrian will not cross the road as they are moving away from the traffic area while maintaining a stationary, observational stance typical of someone waiting rather than preparing to cross.
